calls.note: Thirteen orders, wave-clocked, issued once — the same shape and the same count as round 1's winning gulch plan, so the two are comparable. Three changes, each bought with a receipt from the-claim an hour ago: (1) every trigger is a WAVE, never gold, because a gold trigger can only be served while the hero stands on a live seam and these seams hold 30 gold (~9s) before they go dark; (2) the turret ladder is spaced 2-2-2-3 instead of 2-2-2-2, because the fourth turret at 125 is the rung that missed on the-claim — twice — and this map's 40% richer seams still have to clear it; (3) cells sit within ~1-4wu of an authored seam site so the reflex layer is inside the 6wu placement circle while it is still earning. Beacons come after the turrets (1.14 dps/gold against 0.48) and are spread to cover the claim at (0,12) and both wash mouths. REPAIR_UNDER is last: any order that returns a movement every tick starves everything behind it.
HOLD. Both HARVESTs landed this time — a 36s answer beat the ~9s seam lease where the-claim's 54s answer did not, which is the whole difference between the two receipts. Purse 60, ladder untouched.
HOLD. Turret 1 down at wave 2. Note the seams here carry 40 not 30 — the briefing's 'seams pay 40% more' shows up as capacity, so a node is a ~12s lease here rather than ~9s.

HOLD. Purse 90 against the 70 due at wave 4, and the reflex layer is standing ON the live node at (-1.5,-6.4), 0.8wu from that cell — earning inside the placement circle, which is the arrangement the whole plan is built to produce.
HOLD. Two turrets down on schedule, works untouched at 580/580, purse 95 against the 95 due at wave 6.

RE-COMMAND to stop wasting the purse. 175 gold at wave 5 against a 200 bank cap and ~66/wave of income means the next two waves earn nothing at all — the cap is the binding constraint, and my gate plan left the whole beacon bench idling until wave 11. Restating ONLY what is still undone (the two done turrets and the two done HARVESTs are deliberately absent, so the replace cannot buy anything twice), pulling turret 4 forward one wave and the six beacons forward four to six, spaced so no two come due on the same tick and every price clears its wave with the cap full. Note for the record that bankCap is not in THE VIEW at all — I know it is 200 because the reflex layer hands it to me out of band.

HOLD, and record the cost of the last answer honestly: orders-2-1 is a DUPLICATE I created myself. The original wave-6 turret fired and placed at (7,7) during the 42s I spent composing the re-command, so my restated copy of it came due the instant it landed and died — on range, with the hero 14wu away by then. The inventory a rider reads is stale by exactly its own latency, so a restated order must be one whose trigger cannot fire while you are still typing. Nothing lost but the order: turrets read 3, the fourth is still pending at wave 8, and the beacon bench starts next wave.

HOLD, deliberately, against the temptation to fix a second dead order. orders-2-2 (beacon at (-4,8), wave 7) failed: purse 159 against a 25 price, so it was range again — that cell is 5.2wu from the nearest authored seam site, just outside the band where the reflex layer can stand AND earn, and no node near it was live when the wave turned. I could re-site it. I am not going to, and the arithmetic is the reason: four of the five beacons still pending are already sited within 3.9wu of a seam, the works have taken zero damage in seven waves, and the only order whose trigger falls inside my own answering time is the wave-8 turret — restating it is exactly the mistake that killed orders-2-1 one call ago. Two more beacons are not worth risking the fourth turret. The plan stands.

RE-COMMAND. Two more orders are dead — the wave-8 turret at (2,-7) and the wave-9 beacon at (4,8) — with 267 in the purse against prices of 125 and 25, so neither died of money. Both cells were ones I had never seen anything placed on. Every cell that HAS worked on this map is within 2wu of a standing turret: (-8,7), (-2,-7), (7,7). So the new bench is sited by precedent rather than by hope, each cell 2wu from proven ground and >=4wu from its neighbours to clear the 1.2+1.2 overlap radii. Triggers are waves 11/13/15/17/19: sixty seconds apart so the reflex layer can walk between the north and south lines, and all beyond my own answering time so none of them can fire while I am still typing — which is how orders-2-1 died. Turret first: 1.14 dps per gold against a beacon's 0.48.

HOLD, and the diagnosis is finally exact. orders-3-1 died with 258 in the purse against a 125 price and the reflex layer VISIBLY EN ROUTE — standingFor shows it walking to (-0.04,-3.20) for the cell (0,-7) when the wave turned, 9.7wu short. The cell was not bad ground and the money was not short: the order simply came due while the hero was still crossing the map from the seam it had been working at (-9,6.7). That is the true shape of the constraint — a one-shot, hero-range-gated BUILD gives the reflex layer a window no longer than the trigger's own predictability, and one wave's last nine seconds is not enough to cross this gulch. The four beacons still pending are 60s apart, the works are at 692/708 in wave 11 of 20, and another re-command would only add another cell I have not seen anything stand on. The plan runs.
HOLD. Works back to full 708/708, hero 142/150, twelve waves held with zero works lost. REPAIR_UNDER has fired again this submission. Next beacon due at wave 13.

RE-COMMAND, and this failure is a different animal from the last three. orders-3-2 died at (-4,-7) with 247 gold, a 35 price, and the hero 4.4wu away — inside the 6wu circle. Not money, not range: OVERLAP. A beacon went up at (-5,-7) during my previous answering window, one wu from the cell I then named, and beacon-on-beacon needs 1.2+1.2 = 2.4wu of clearance. I could not have avoided it from THE VIEW: now.works gives byKind counts and a total hp bar and NEVER A SINGLE COORDINATE, so a rider cannot see where its own works stand. The only positions I know are the ones I ordered myself — and my last plan sited all three remaining beacons exactly 2.0wu from a standing turret, which is inside 2.4 and would have killed every one of them. Re-siting to >=3.0wu from every building whose position I know, keeping them all on the north line so the hero never has to cross the gulch between triggers, and spending the fat purse on the fourth turret first at 1.14 dps/gold against 0.48. Triggers 16/18/19, all beyond my own answering time. The eight territory palisades remain a blind spot I cannot price.

HOLD. Works fully mended to 708/708 — REPAIR_UNDER earned its slot. Turret due at wave 16 with 217 in hand against 125.

calls.note: ONE WAVE-CLOCKED PLAN AT THE GATE, then HOLD. Wave triggers, not gold triggers, on purpose: a gold trigger can only be served where the purse rises, i.e. standing on a live seam, and the seams here hold 30 gold (six 5-gold ticks, ~9s) before they go dark — so a gold-triggered cell is a moving target. A wave trigger is a clock the reflex layer can walk to. Every cell sits within ~1-3.6wu of an authored seam site AND at |z|>=7, off the river band (Terrain refuses -5<=z<=5), so the hero is inside the 6wu placement circle while it is still earning. Spacing: one build every two waves, so no two orders come due on the same tick and the purse always clears the price (turret ladder 50/70/95/125 against ~1.5 gold/s). The two HARVESTs name LIVE node ids, not the stablePrefix anchor ids, because those two lists disagree from the first frame (prefix says gold-seam-1 is at -22,-6.8; the live node called gold-seam-1 is at -9,6.7). REPAIR_UNDER sits last because any order that returns a movement every tick starves everything behind it.

HOLD. The plan is complete and wave-clocked; re-commanding would replace the whole record set, resetting four unfired BUILDs and re-firing the HARVEST that already paid. Two receipts to note rather than react to: HARVEST gold-seam-1 died INVALID_TARGET because that node went dark during my 54s of thinking (it was live and full when I was called) — a seam id is a 9-second lease, not a place; and HARVEST gold-seam-2 landed, taking the node from 30 to 25, i.e. one 5-gold tick, which is what the whole verb is worth. Nothing about either changes the build ladder.

HOLD. Turret 1 is on the ground at (-8,7) — the first BUILD a rider has ever placed through the shipped pipeline in this rehearsal; buildingsBuilt reads 1 and the works pool grew by 50hp. The ladder is on schedule: purse 95 against a 70 price due at wave 4. Nothing to change.

The id/place mapping moves DURING the run, so the name in a HARVEST order is not a place — which is why orders-1-6 died on a node that was live when I named it.

HOLD. Two turrets down, both on schedule, works never damaged. The reflex layer is standing on the live node at (7.5,6.5), which is 0.7wu from the wave-6 cell (7,7): earning and inside the placement circle at the same time. That is the whole point of naming cells next to seam sites.

HOLD on a surprise. REPAIR_UNDER 50 has gone done — the Prospector walked to a hurt palisade and mended it through the shipped repair verb, the one order in this plan that needed no rung above 1. Hero still at full, purse 88, ladder unchanged.

The only live node is out at (25,6.9), 18wu from the wave-6 cell, so the reflex layer will have to leave paying ground for the last few seconds and walk in on the wave clock. That is exactly the case a gold trigger could not have survived and a wave trigger can.

HOLD. Turret 3 landed at (7,7) on the wave-6 tick with the nearest live node 18wu away — the walk-in on the wave clock worked, three of three BUILDs placed. Purse 58 against the 125 due at wave 8: two waves at the observed ~1.7 gold/s is ~100, so it clears. Works have taken zero damage in six waves.

RE-COMMAND, deliberately, and the first one this rehearsal has spent. orders-1-4 (turret at (2,-7), waveGte 8) is dead: the wave arrived with 98 in the purse against a 125 price, and a BUILD gets exactly one attempt, so the trigger destroyed its own order. Re-commanding is normally ruinous because a submission REPLACES the record set — but that only costs you what you RESTATE, and now.works.byKind already tells me the three turrets are on the ground, so I restate neither them nor anything else. The new list is two orders and nothing else: the missed turret pushed to wave 9, where ~30s at the observed 1.7 gold/s puts the purse near 150; and the beacon pushed to wave 10 so it cannot collide on the same tick, and so it still has a chance if the turret misses again and leaves the purse full.
